import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv('/app/data/train.csv')
val = pd.read_csv('/app/data/val.csv')
test = pd.read_csv('/app/data/test.csv')

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Val shape: {val.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Separate features and target
X_train = train.drop('target', axis=1)
y_train = train['target']
X_val = val.drop('target', axis=1)
y_val = val['target']
X_test = test.copy()

print(f"\nTarget distribution in train: {y_train.value_counts().to_dict()}")
print(f"Target distribution in val: {y_val.value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Handle missing values - fill with median for numerical
print("\nHandling missing values...")
for col in X_train.columns:
    if X_train[col].isna().any():
        median_val = X_train[col].median()
        X_train[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)
        X_val[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)
        X_test[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)

# Train LightGBM model
print("\nTraining LightGBM model...")
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=8,
    num_leaves=64,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=-1
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validate
val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"\nValidation ROC-AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Save predictions
predictions = pd.DataFrame({'target': test_pred})
predictions.to_csv('/app/predictions.csv', index=False)
print(f"\nPredictions saved to /app/predictions.csv")
print(f"Number of predictions: {len(predictions)}")
print(f"All finite: {np.all(np.isfinite(test_pred))}")
EOF

val = pd.read_csv('/app/data/val.csv')
test = pd.read_csv('/app/data/test.csv')

# Separate features and target
X_train = train.drop('target', axis=1)
y_train = train['target']
X_val = val.drop('target', axis=1)
y_val = val['target']
X_test = test.copy()

print(f"Train shape: {X_train.shape}")
print(f"Target distribution: Class 0: {(y_train==0).sum()}, Class 1: {(y_train==1).sum()}")

for col in X_train.columns:
    if X_train[col].isna().any():
        median_val = X_train[col].median()
        X_train[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)
        X_val[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)
        X_test[col].fillna(median_val, inplace=True)

# Calculate class weight for imbalance
class_0 = (y_train == 0).sum()
class_1 = (y_train == 1).sum()
scale_pos_weight = class_0 / class_1
print(f"Scale pos weight: {scale_pos_weight:.4f}")

params_list = [

    print(f"Model {i+1} ROC-AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")
    if val_auc > best_score:
        best_score = val_auc
        best_model = model
        best_params = params

print(f"\nBest model ROC-AUC: {best_score:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions with best model
